summary: Preserve same-host native continuity for idle suspensions without Git snapshots

replay.detail: Idle snapshot receipts can select in-place mode for four existing workspace refusal classes. Manual captures retain their Git requirements. No automatic idle producer is enabled.

schema.detail: No SQLite schema transition. Host-local payload manifests add a mode field with absent meaning Git.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change or new claim kind.

compatibility.detail: Requires suspension cause/mode readers on every active member before idle writers are enabled. In-place payloads contain a frozen native transcript but no Git bundle; older restorers cannot restore them. Do not downgrade after activation.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond ordinary daemon replacement.

manual.detail: An in-place suspension can resume only on its source host, including after conversion to a manual hold. Cross-host requests refuse with snapshot-in-place.

recovery.detail: Capture mode persists across restart before its receipt. Same-host restore validates the sealed native identity and workspace path, reuses a checked native inventory across retries, and never recreates or replaces the workspace. Missing or divergent transcript bytes refuse resume.
